rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses sponsored or approved by the Florida PT Association (FPTA) or APTA (incl. other state chapters and sections); courses by an accredited PT/PTA college program (1 college credit hour = 15 contact hours). Other credit: attending a Board meeting, past Board members on a Probable Cause Panel, passing the Florida Laws and Rules exam within the biennium (not when taken for discipline, initial licensure, reactivation or reinstatement), CE course instructors up to 6 hours, APTA-credentialed clinical instructors 1 hour per 120 internship hours (max 8). Limits: home study max 12 hours, risk management max 5, HIV/AIDS max 3, medical errors max 3.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licenses issued in the second half of the biennium: exempt except 2 hours Prevention of Medical Errors and 1 hour HIV/AIDS. HIV/AIDS (1 hour) is required for the first renewal only.
rules.audit_note: All CE must be reported to CE Broker before renewal; submitting the renewal acknowledges compliance with CE requirements.

topics.who: Prevention of Medical Errors, every renewal (courses approved by any MQA board accepted)

rules.legal_basis: Fla. Stat. §486.109; Fla. Admin. Code R. 64B17-9.001
rules.notes: 24 contact hours = 22 general + 2 medical errors (1 CEU = 10 contact hours). Biennium ends November 30 of odd years (current licenses expire November 30, 2027). Same requirement for PTs and PTAs. Public school volunteers may waive up to 25% of hours (not medical errors, HIV/AIDS or domestic violence).
